name: html-runtime-decorative-canvas-native-decomposition
description: A decorative aria-hidden background canvas does not make its page wrapper a runtime application shell when other runtime-bound controls exist on the page.

source_reference.notes: Product-neutral page wrapper with a header, a hero holding an unbound decorative canvas, and two runtime-targeted controls; the wrapper stays editable native blocks.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
